title: Azizi Florence
summary: A planned residential community in Sharjah alongside Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), with villa and townhouse designs, landscaped parkland and planned leisure amenities.

children.text: Azizi Florence is a planned residential community in Sharjah alongside Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311). The wider masterplan brings together apartments, villas and townhouses with landscaped parkland and neighbourhood amenities.

The villa designs comprise four-, five- and six-bedroom homes over three floors. The townhouse designs include three- and four-bedroom homes arranged in four-, six- and eight-home groups, with a choice of corner and middle layouts.

Planned outdoor spaces include gardens, walking, running and cycling routes, sports courts, children's play areas and picnic areas. Planned neighbourhood amenities include clubhouses, swimming pools, fitness and wellness facilities, cafes and electric-vehicle charging.
